Circular wall decoration (dartboard/wreath) | top-left above coat hook in opening shots | appears as wreath-like object on upper wall in final shot | apparent position shift attributable to camera angle change and depth differential; not a confirmed defect
Wall-mounted wooden box/fixture | on wall section right of the man's head | not visible in final shot | plausibly out of frame after camera move

Far door with framed bird artwork | far right of opening shots | final shot shows paneled door with doorknob at right, artwork cropped out of frame | compatible with the same door seen from a closer/lower angle
